$comment: St. John's step 7d kit: what was done to maps/test_coverage.json in MapMaker, in order, so it can be replayed on a later version of the map (a Playwright driver clicks these: the Set pieces tab's card, R to turn, the level strip, a click on the cell, then the set piece inspector's Options, one option a selection; the Tiles tab's card and a click for the tile; Export). Cells are the map's grid (x east, y north); every piece on the ground, unturned, not mirrored. A mess hall in little along row -60: the fireplace end with drink stations, a bay with doors and a cross aisle, the serving bay and the kitchen, all on a sunk floor; then a bay on a level floor with the arcade and drink stations, a sunk bay with Steps up and the twin arches, and a Sunk Room by itself.
